VDN-2847 (revatimod) Phase 3 - Study VDN-2847-301
Data package README
Data cut: 2026-10-30
Prepared by: Clinical Data Management

FILES
- ae_listing_VDN2847_v3.csv: treatment-emergent AEs, one row per event. Column pt_category is the SOC-level grouping; events in the hepatobiliary family are tagged 'hepatic'.
- lab_values_VDN2847_v2.csv: serial AST, ALT, ALP, total bilirubin by visit and arm.
- protocol_stub_VDN2847.md: excerpt of Section 7.4 (safety reporting).

EFFICACY (summary)
ADAS-Cog13 change from baseline at Week 78 favored revatimod over placebo. Full LS mean difference and CIs are in the CSR draft, not in this package.

SAFETY (summary)
Hepatic signal: 16 of 500 revatimod-treated patients (3.2%) had AST and/or ALT elevations. Peak values reached 3.1x ULN. Protocol Section 7.4 defines the reportable-event threshold as ALT or AST >3x ULN, and these cases meet that threshold. Placebo arm: 2 of 498 (0.4%).

ATTRIBUTION
Concomitant medications (statins and acetaminophen in several cases) and pre-existing comorbidities (NAFLD, T2DM) may explain some of the cases. Causality has not been adjudicated. The Hepatic Safety Committee has not reviewed these cases.

NOTES
Lab values are reported as-entered by site; no central lab re-read has been performed for 4 of the 16 cases.
</tool_result>
